audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item targets EL (Execution Layer) withdrawal object construction validation. Target codebase is Prysm, a CL (Consensus Layer) client. CL creates withdrawal objects; EL processes and validates them for crediting ETH. The validation logic being audited (incomplete object rejection during construction) is an EL responsibility, not implemented in CL code.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: Withdrawal object construction validation with field completeness checks
evidence.finding: All withdrawal-related code in Prysm handles CL-side withdrawal preparation and state management, not EL-side validation of incoming withdrawal objects.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item targets EL type validation of withdrawal addresses (20-byte Address) and amounts (U256). Target codebase is Prysm (CL). The CL creates withdrawals using beacon chain types; the EL receives them via Engine API and performs type validation. This validation is EL-specific code.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: Type validation of withdrawal address (20-byte) and amount (U256) at EL boundary
evidence.finding: Prysm produces withdrawal objects; it does not consume and validate them.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Checklist item verifies that ETH is credited only to addresses specified by CL in withdrawal objects. This is an EL state crediting operation. Prysm (CL) sends withdrawal instructions to EL but does not execute the crediting logic. The audit target is EL withdrawal processing code.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: ETH crediting to withdrawal.address during EL withdrawal processing
evidence.finding: CL does not credit ETH; it instructs EL to credit. Crediting logic is in EL execution engine.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Bloom filter computation is an EL-specific operation for transaction receipt logs. Prysm is a CL client and does not implement bloom filters. Bloom filters are used in EL for log filtering and receipt validation. No bloom filter code exists in Prysm.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: Bloom filter bytearray bounds checking (256 bytes, no out-of-bounds access)
evidence.finding: No bloom filter code found in Prysm. Bloom filters are EL constructs for transaction receipt logs.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: 11-bit mask (0x07FF) in bloom bit computation is an EL bloom filter implementation detail. Prysm (CL) does not implement bloom filters. This audit target requires EL code.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: Correctness of 11-bit mask (0x07FF) in bloom filter bit computation
evidence.finding: No bloom filter implementation in CL code.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: byte_index computation for bloom filter is EL-specific. Prysm does not implement bloom filters.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: byte_index range validation [0, 255] in bloom filter computation
evidence.finding: No bloom filter code in Prysm.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: add_to_bloom iteration logic (3 iterations reading 2-byte pairs) is EL bloom filter implementation. Not present in Prysm (CL).

evidence.checklist_item_focus: add_to_bloom loop structure with exactly 3 iterations
evidence.finding: No add_to_bloom or equivalent function in CL code.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Bloom filter initialization (256 zero bytes) is EL-specific. Prysm does not implement bloom filters.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: Bloom filter initialization to 256 zero bytes before log processing
evidence.finding: No bloom filter initialization code in Prysm.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Log address addition to bloom filter is part of EL receipt processing. Prysm (CL) does not process transaction logs or compute bloom filters.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: Each log address added to bloom exactly once during receipt processing
evidence.finding: CL does not process transaction logs or receipts; EL responsibility.

audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: Log topic addition to bloom filter is EL receipt processing logic. Prysm (CL) does not implement this functionality.

evidence.checklist_item_focus: Each log topic added to bloom exactly once (1 + len(topics) calls per log)
evidence.finding: No log topic processing or bloom filter code in CL.
